Detailed Description

A UnaryOpUGen usually created using the function log() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultLog  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).log (); // creates a UnaryLogUGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultLog  =  log(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4)); // creates a UnaryLogUGen
See also:
